In detail

Buenavista was the site of a well-documented organised-crime occupation racket: a criminal network sold illegal access to roughly 28-30 vacant flats in a residential building for 2,000-3,000 euros each, causing two months of tension (December 2024-February 2025) before ringleaders were arrested and the building cleared. A serious but contained and resolved episode rather than a persistent pattern. Sources checked: El Espanol, 8 Jan 2025; El Diario/Somos Madrid, 7 Feb 2025.
